title: character count fieldset legend
rule: Character count when a limit is justified; consider word count if more helpful; fieldset+legend to group related controls. (Also named, merged here: break a hard open question into radios instead of one textarea.)

citation.source: GOV.UK Design System — Character count; GOV.UK Design System — Fieldset

pass_when: A justified limit uses a character count (or word count if that is more helpful). Related controls are grouped with fieldset and legend. A hard open question is radios rather than one textarea when that split applies.
fail_when: Unjustified limit with no count; related controls ungrouped; a hard closed choice dumped into a textarea.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: M3 swap supporting text for error (`forms.errors.replace_supporting_text`).
